subject: Redwood SaaS listing: metering & fulfillment go-live
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Hsu <linda.hsu@amazon.com>, marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood SaaS listing: metering & fulfillment go-live

Team / Linda,

Thanks again for the quick intake last week. We have a target go-live date of 2026-10-01 for Acme Analytics (RDW-ACME-2026-09). Before we flip the switch I want to make sure we’ve covered the Marketplace metering + fulfillment items so billing and entitlements are clean.

High-level asks (can we mark owners and ETA?):
- Finalized SaaS contract with explicit metering clause and fulfillment responsibility (attached: SaaSContract_Redwood-Acme_2026-09.pdf) — owner: Legal / Sales
- Entitlement token schema + TTL and test token window (attached: entitlement_schema.yml) — owner: Platform
- Fulfillment manifest for the SaaS product (attached stub) — owner: Product Ops
- End-to-end test plan: test entitlements, simulated usage, billing confirmation with AWS billing team — owner: Marketplace Ops + Redwood Billing

Linda, can you confirm what Marketplace team needs from us to run an end-to-end test? Specifically:
- Preferred test SKU and test entitlements format
- Any DocuSign/contract routing expectations for SaaS contracts in your system
- Contact on the AWS Billing side we should loop in for verification

We’ve also included a working DocuSign link in the related links that Legal will send to Acme once we align on the final clause. Rafael, Marissa, Karthik — please comment on the ownership bullets above; I’ll consolidate and follow up with a short call if needed.

Thanks,

-- 
Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0142

Attachments: SaaSContract_Redwood-Acme_2026-09.pdf (pdf), entitlement_schema.yml (yaml), fulfillment_manifest.json (json)

From: Linda Hsu <linda.hsu@amazon.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace-ops@amazon.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood SaaS listing: metering & fulfillment go-live

Hi Priyom (and team),

Thanks — this is a good checklist. For AWS Marketplace Ops to run a full metering + fulfillment test, we need the following items from Redwood:

1) Signed SaaS contract that includes the metering clause and an explicit fulfillment owner. The clause should reference the SaaS subscription ID and indicate Redwood handles entitlement issuance via the Marketplace fulfillment lambda.
2) Entitlement schema (YAML or JSON) describing token fields, TTL, and any customer metadata you pass through. We prefer a short TTL (<= 24 hours) for test tokens and a separate long-lived entitlement for active subscriptions.
3) Fulfillment manifest (JSON) with SKU mappings and endpoint for the fulfillment webhook.
4) Test plan doc with test SKUs and step-by-step validation so we can mirror it on our side.

For billing verification, please cc billing-verification@amazon.com once you’re ready to run charges; they will coordinate the reconciliation.

I took a quick pass at the contract and highlighted two small wording items:
- Confirm "Redwood will issue entitlements via a fulfillment endpoint or AWS Marketplace Lambda" — we prefer explicit mention of the fulfillment endpoint URL pattern.
- Add a clause about provisioning delay expectation (e.g., issuance within X seconds/minutes), since metering spikes can cause throttles.

If you can upload the entitlement schema and manifest to the Drive link you provided and confirm the DocuSign route, Marketplace Ops can schedule a test window for the week of 2026-09-22.

Best,
Linda

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Redwood SaaS listing: metering & fulfillment go-live

Thanks Linda — helpful callout. A few clarifications from the Redwood side: 

- Contract language: happy to specify the fulfillment endpoint pattern. Legal prefers not to hard-code a URL in the contract; proposed wording: "Redwood will configure and maintain a secure fulfillment endpoint which communicates entitlement issuance to AWS Marketplace in accordance with the fulfillment manifest." If that’s acceptable to Marketplace we can add the one-line provision Linda suggested about expected issuance latency (we propose "typically within 30s under normal load").

- Entitlement schema: attaching a draft entitlement_schema.yml — key fields: customer_id, subscription_id, sku, issued_at, expires_at, signature. For tests we’ll issue short-lived tokens (TTL = 6h) and a separate monthly subscription entitlement for billing.

- Fulfillment manifest: we'll map our internal product SKU (rdw-core-enterprise) to the AWS SKU you assign. Rafael will coordinate the SKU mapping with Marketplace Ops once AWS provides the SKU list.

Quote from Linda's note for context:

> For billing verification, please cc billing-verification@amazon.com once you’re ready to run charges; they will coordinate the reconciliation.

Action items I’m proposing: 
- Rafael: finalize manifest + entitlement schema by EOD 2026-09-17.
- Karthik: prepare a test harness that can consume the Marketplace test entitlements and simulate usage up to 5k tokens/min for the test window.
- Marissa: confirm DocuSign routing and sales contact for Acme.

@Linda — does the Marketplace team need anything else to approve the test window week of 2026-09-22?

Thanks,
Rafael

-- 
Rafael Mendes
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Attachment: entitlement_schema.yml (draft), fulfillment_manifest.json (draft)

Great — thanks everyone. Quick status update and owners: 

- Legal (Marissa) will push the revised contract PDF with the fulfillment endpoint language by 2026-09-17 17:00 PT. Will upload signed DocuSign once Legal approves routing.
- Rafael: will upload final entitlement_schema.yml + fulfillment_manifest.json to the Drive folder and ping Marketplace Ops when done.
- Karthik: infra will run the test harness and provide logs; aiming for test window 2026-09-23 10:00 PT.

If Marketplace Ops can confirm the SKU assignment and billing contact we’ll lock the test window. If anyone prefers a short 20-minute sync today to close open Qs, I’m available at 11:30 or 16:00 PT.

Looks good from Sales — Jared at Acme is on standby for the DocuSign send once contract wording is set (cc’d on earlier threads).

Thanks,
Marissa
